company.name: fluently
company.description:
fluently is a SaaS marketplace for professional translation that let’s you manage all your translation needs in one place, online. The matching algorithm then suggests the perfect team of vetted translators to ensure translations are on-brand, every time.

Their software helps B2B customers who typically outsource their translation needs to agencies to access the very same translators directly, cutting out the middle-man and thus creating a win/win scenario for customers and translators alike.
